remarks:
Welcome to 142 Geary St, where classic Buffalo character meets thoughtful modern updates. This 3-bedroom, 1 full bath home offers 1,856 sq ft of living space and a layout that blends charm with functionality.

A welcoming enclosed sunroom introduces the home and leads into a spacious front entry. Throughout, you’ll find beautifully preserved original wood details, including hardwood floors, original wood doors, and rich woodwork that highlight the home’s timeless character.

The main level features a large living room that flows into a formal dining room, perfect for entertaining. The kitchen has new vinyl flooring installed in 2026 and all appliances (2019) are included. Upstairs features an expansive bathroom with a newer tub surround and new vinyl flooring (2026), three bedrooms; one with a walk-in closet. 

The full basement includes glass block windows for added security and natural light, along with dry-locked walls (2026) and a new sump pump (2026) for added peace of mind. Washer (2024) and dryer included. 

Numerous updates provide long-term value, including painting the aluminum siding (2023), replacement vinyl windows, updated electric with new service line, some copper plumbing, chimney repair and relining 2025, and a garage roof replacement 2020. The furnace has been serviced with updated components, and the hot water tank was replaced in 2013.

Outside, enjoy a private backyard setting with privacy fencing, a rear patio, and a detached garage with a new roof (2020). Conveniently located near Cazenovia Park, local shops, and restaurants, with recent area improvements including Geary Street repaving (2025) and new sidewalks along Seneca Street(2026).
